title: Water
html:
See also: Water (surface)

Water is a common Miscellaneous item found throughout the game. It can be thrown to create a  Water surface.

The Sword Coast's finest well water, bottled for convenience.

Properties

  •  Miscellaneous Items
  •  Single Use
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb)
  •  Price: 5 gp

    Stats CONS_DRINK_Water_Bottle

Effect

 Action

  •  Throw this bottle to create a water surface.
    •  Range: 18 m (60 ft)
    • Creates area: Water
    • Gives the  Wet condition on any creatures in the splash zone.

Condition: Wet

 Wet

Duration: 3 turns

  • Immune to  Burning and  Wild Magic: Burning.
  • Resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Vulnerable to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Cold damage.

Area: Water

 Water

Duration: Permanent

 AoE: 2 m (7 ft) Radius

Douses unprotected flames. Can be electrified or frozen.

Type: Surface

Water is a common Miscellaneous item found throughout the game. It can be thrown to create a  Water surface.
